title: Study on cold-sprayed Fe-based metallic glass reinforced Cu composite coatings applied to 6061 T6 Al alloy base material

preSprayedProperties.Substrate_Surface_Preparation: treated with an SJK 9070 F dry sandblasting machine, followed by ultrasonic cleaning in ethanol

preSprayedProperties.Overall_Powder_Name: Pure Cu powder + Fe-Based Metallic Glass
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Blend_Ratio: 95 wt% pure Cu, 5 wt% Fe-based metallic glass
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Production_Method: mixed with pure Cu powders in mass fraction of 5 % using a QM-QX-4L MITR planetary ball mill
preSprayedProperties.Powder_Heat_Treatment_Description: dried in a vacuum oven at 80 ◦C for 24 h

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: decreased coating thickness compared to pure CU powder approximately 250 ± 10 μm
